ValidationRule.description: Validates owner of the Contact: The owner must be an internal (BBVA) user
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, CONTAINS(RecordType.DeveloperName, 'Desktop_Contact'), OR (CONTAINS(Owner.Username, '.becas@'), CONTAINS(Owner.Username, '.contractor@')), NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The owner must be an internal user.
